subject: Evaluation milestone & environment commitments (keys, org, allowlist, peering)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Liu <dana.liu@novamed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 09:52:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluation milestone & environment commitments (keys, org, allowlist, peering)

Hi Dana —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. To keep the evaluation moving toward a decision, I put together a short set of environment commitments we need to complete in the MAP so your team can run production-like traffic during the trial. Goal: finish infra and credentials in 7–10 business days so we can start generator load tests the week after.

High-level asks (minimal to get started):
- Org invite: add redwood-ops@redwood.ai as a collaborator in your evaluation org (or create a service account with equivalent permissions).
- API keys: please enable a scoped API key for the evaluation environment and share the secret via your secrets channel (we can accept a short-lived token for initial work).
- IP allowlist: we need 3 IPs to open on your firewall for control plane callbacks and health checks — see ranges in the attached MAP.
- VPC peering: request peering between Novamed-staging and Redwood-eval (CIDR suggestions below).
- Contact for networking: introduce your cloudops contact so we can coordinate the peering window and test routing.

Proposed timeline:
- Day 0 (today): agree on MAP doc and list owners
- Day 1–3: org invite + API key + initial allowlist entries
- Day 4–7: VPC peering established and validated; redwood_poc_onboarding runbook applied
- Day 8–10: smoke tests and generate-load verification

CIDR suggestions for peering (examples, please confirm):
- Novamed-stg: 10.50.0.0/16
- Redwood-eval: 10.80.0.0/16

I attached a short MAP spreadsheet with milestones and owners (MAP_Redwood-For-Novamed.xlsx). If these steps look good I can convert to a living MAP in Drive and schedule a 30-min handoff with your cloudops and security folks.

Thanks — I’ll coordinate internal owners (cc Marissa for exec updates; Monica will lead the CS handoff once infra is green).

—
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: MAP_Redwood-For-Novamed.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Dana Liu <dana.liu@novamed.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: cloudops@novamed.com
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 09:15:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Evaluation milestone & environment commitments (keys, org, allowlist, peering)

Ben —

Appreciate the clear checklist. Confirming Novamed is aligned to move forward with the items below. Quick notes before we schedule the peering window:

- Org invite: please provide the email for the service account you recommend (we prefer service accounts for evals).
- API key: our security team prefers short-lived keys for trials; can you accept a token that expires in 14 days?
- IP allowlist: we can provision rules but need the exact ports and public IPs. Can you also confirm whether callbacks use TLS on 443 or a custom port?
- VPC peering: cloudops requested a formal peering request ticket with CIDR confirmation and planned maintenance window (we typically do peering Tue–Thu 02:00–05:00 UTC).

I attached Novamed's standard network config template for third-party peering (network_config_template.csv) and a SOC summary our compliance team likes to share for evals. I'll loop in our cloudops primary (cloudops@novamed.com) to this thread — they will own the peering ticket.

If you can drop the exact IPs/ports and the service-account email, I’ll open the peering request and catalog the MAP milestones on our side.

Thanks,
Dana
Director, Product Operations | Novamed
dana.liu@novamed.com

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, cloudops@novamed.com
Date: Fri, 20 Jun 2025 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation milestone & environment commitments (keys, org, allowlist, peering)

Dana —

Thanks — great questions. Answers and concrete items below so your cloudops ticket has everything it needs.

1) Service account
- Please add: redwood-eval-sa@redwood.ai (IAM role: api-eval-invoke). We will rotate the key after first validation; 14-day token is fine for the initial window.

2) IPs and ports
- Public egress IPs to allow (TLS 443): 34.82.16.110, 34.82.16.111, 34.82.16.112
- Control plane callback endpoints use HTTPS (443) only. No custom ports required.

3) Peering details to include in request
- Your CIDR: 10.50.0.0/16 (confirm)
- Our CIDR: 10.80.0.0/16
- Route exchange: advertise only eval subnets; no transitive routing
- Suggested maintenance window: Tue 2025-06-24 02:00–04:00 UTC (please confirm)

4) Artifacts for the MAP
- I uploaded the MAP spreadsheet to Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/NVMD-MAP-v1 (milestones, owners, dates).
- Attached: redwood_poc_onboarding.pdf — runbook for smoke tests and health checks.

5) Owners
- Redwood CS: Monica Patel (monica.patel@redwood.ai) — will drive validation once peering is up
- Redwood Net Eng: Marissa Cole — will be on the peering call for route validation

Next steps I propose:
- You open the peering ticket and copy the ticket ID back here
- We schedule a 30-min handoff (cloudops + Marissa + Monica) for the maintenance window

If that works I’ll mark the MAP items as in-progress and we can close them as completed in the Drive sheet.

—
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_poc_onboarding.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Dana Liu <dana.liu@novamed.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: cloudops@novamed.com
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2025 21:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Evaluation milestone & environment commitments (keys, org, allowlist, peering)

Ben —

All good — I filed the peering ticket (TICKET-9483) and set the maintenance window to Tue 2025-06-24 02:00–04:00 UTC per your suggestion. cloudops@novamed.com will reach out to Marissa directly to share route tables and verify there is no overlap.

We will also create the short-lived API token and share via our secure vault (I’ll paste a link once it’s provisioned). Expect the service-account invite to appear in your inbox by Monday. Monica, hi — looking forward to the validation run.

Appreciate the quick turn — this MAP cadence makes it straightforward to track milestones.

Thanks,
Dana
